name: Credit Health
desc_id: Dibangun karena hampir semua tool keuangan pribadi yang layak memasang tarif $99–109/tahun dan mengunci fitur dasar di balik paywall. Saya ingin membuktikan dashboard finansial berfitur lengkap bisa dibangun dan dibagikan gratis.
desc_en: Built because nearly every decent personal finance tool charges $99–109 a year and locks basic features behind a paywall. I wanted to prove a full-featured financial dashboard could be free.
